evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh (cargo test incl. 8 preparation::context tests, bun, node, tsc, gallery 150 passed); review subagent: no blocking spec or lean findings

notes:
Did: preparation/context.rs with pub CHARS_PER_TOKEN = 4, Budget {per_source_tokens, total_tokens} and build(pool, app_data_dir, &[SelectedSource], budget) -> Result<PackedContext, SelectionError>. PackedContext is {pieces, manifest}. pieces is ContextPiece[], either {kind:'passage', versionId, passageId, ordinal, locatorJson, text} or {kind:'knowledge', meetingId, itemId, text}, in user order and then passage ordinal. manifest has one ManifestEntry {source, status, (kept, total when truncated), reason, tokens} per selected source, in user order. Statuses and reasons: included WITHIN_BUDGET; truncated {kept,total} or omitted, each with SOURCE_BUDGET or TOTAL_BUDGET depending on which limit applied; deleted DOCUMENT_DELETED; missing MANAGED_FILE_MISSING (the managed_path no longer exists under app data); unavailable VERSION_NOT_FOUND or KNOWLEDGE_NOT_ELIGIBLE. Eligibility is re-checked through list_eligible_items, once per distinct meeting, and an invalid meeting id gives KNOWLEDGE_NOT_ELIGIBLE. A passage costs chars.div_ceil(4) tokens. Each source gets min(per_source, total remaining), and packing stops at the first passage that does not fit, so a cut always falls on a passage boundary and a later smaller passage is never pulled in. The budget logic is a pure pack() fn. 8 tests in preparation::context, including a 500-case seeded xorshift property test over generated sizes. Breaking the stop condition, the per-source limit and the deleted check each fails at least one test (checked by hand).
Assumptions: build takes the pool and the app data dir alongside selection and budget. A knowledge piece's text is the item text only; owner and due are left out, and B2 can add them if the briefing needs them. The context is structured pieces rather than a rendered string, so B2 can cite passage and item ids; 'byte-identical' is tested on the serde_json bytes of the whole PackedContext.
Learned: a version whose document row is missing would report deleted, but the FK on document_versions.document_id makes that unreachable. A version with zero passages would show as included with 0 tokens; ingest refuses empty text, so this cannot happen today. build has no caller yet: B2 should call selection::list and then context::build.
